method: Independent ordinary SupportTest enumeration and explicit A/B/C label construction
scope: All positive-margin binary tables of dimensions 1..3 by 1..3; all 2x2 tables with entries 0..3. U ranges from 0 through max margin + 1.
limitation: Finite diagnostic evidence; mathematical argument and compiled Lean theorem carry universal claim.

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportCount_spanning_lower
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
      Fintype.card
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) -
          1 ≤
        Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportCount r c U X

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.augmentedInverseSupportAllowance_le_count
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.augmentedInverseSupportAllowance r c U ≤
        Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportCount r c U X
